Applicant Tracking Systems
A powerful talent acquisition platform for all of your talent needs
Ceipal is a total talent management platform that delivers unparalleled strategic insight into the comprehensive talent landscape. Ceipal helps staffing firms, MSPs, system integrators, and corporate hiring teams of all sizes attract and retain the best available talent with robust AI solutions.
Applicant Tracking System (ATS): AI-powered ATS automatically delivers high-quality talent to your dashboard while integrating with your hiring workflow for a more efficient talent acquisition process.
Recruitment CRM: Ceipal helps organizations proactively identify opportunities, engage candidates, and automate outreach so they can hire the best talent more efficiently.
ProcureWise VMS: A flexible, powerful, and user-friendly vendor management system that empowers organizations to manage talent supplies more effectively.
Diversity Hiring: Uses our advanced AI capabilities to assess, plan, and implement a roadmap to a more diverse workforce.
Workforce Management: Helps organizations effectively oversee talent, from centralized onboarding to robust exit management.
Ceipal's customers have experienced 4x growth within six months of adopting the platform with up to 70% increase in recruitment productivity and 50% cost savings.
